name: Testimonials
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site testimonial sections, in the layouts of the Untitled UI testimonial sections the marketing team picked (layout only; no Untitled UI photo or asset): Simple centred (3), Simple left aligned, Split image (3), Card, Card split image, Case study cards, Glassmorphic cards (3), Social cards (3) and Abstract image. Every placeholder is a real image file; the quote, rating, avatar, name and role styles are the DS Testimonial card. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Seventeen layouts, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet

Every placeholder (customer photos, avatars, split photo, collage, case study covers, post pictures) is an pointing at a real image file with alt text, never a drawn box or initials; the files and their sources are listed in marketing/images/testimonials/manifest.json
Quote, system-star rating, 44px avatar, name and role styles are the Testimonial card of the Cards page; the large quote uses the marketing type scale and the radius is the marketing radius

Carousel layouts are a native scroll-snap track with the DS secondary icon-only button for arrows and plain buttons for dots; no autoplay, the track is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys, and the small script only moves the track

Social cards use the LinkedIn mark from the Logo library by file name; company logos are trimmed copies of the Logos section data (marketing/data/logos-cms.json), kept in greyscale, all rendered at one fixed height with width auto, so every logo shares the same left edge and optical size
Glassmorphic cards sit over a night-sky photo backdrop with a frosted panel (backdrop-filter blur over the photo) and fall back to a solid panel where backdrop blur is not supported
Each section is a container-query block stepping down at 991, 767 and 479px
